scope: A9 executed-dataset provenance and public synthetic manifest integrity
initial_findings: Contract-smoke reported the unexecuted public synthetic dataset hash instead of its executed backend golden dataset hash.
Offline-e2e reported the same unrelated public dataset hash while executing inline pytest fixtures.
The public dataset manifest had no enforced schema/hash/version/record/split/review-status consumer.

findings: Self-asserted approved manifest fields were elevated to completed human review.
Offline source bundle omitted pytest support/config and recursively discovered tests.

independent_review_cycles.finding: Top-level glob still omitted nested directory tests and nested conftest files.

fixes: Removed the public-dataset SHA fallback and bound contract-smoke to the exact executed golden file.
Represented offline fixtures with dataset_sha256=null and a deterministic scoped source-bundle hash.
Matched pytest directory recursion and bound fixed targets, dynamically relevant conftest files and pyproject configuration.
Added a versioned public manifest schema plus hash, count, row-version, split and review-state validation consumed by CI.
Kept pending review explicit and prevented arbitrary approved manifest fields from becoming verified human review.
remaining_external_gates: Human owner review and bound independent receipt for the public corpus
Real provider run and independent request/non-transfer evidence
